shape.description: T-Rex body without legs: big blocky green head on a hinge with an open toothy mouth, a square hole through the top of the head, a brown ribbed marble channel down the back between orange spikes, and a long flat sawtooth tail that is the exit ramp. Speaker grille, switch and button on the chest and belly. Hip sockets each take one leg (M-57, M-59). Armed, head and tail are bent up; fired, the body straightens, head and tail down.
shape.sizeBasis: Rough estimate: one cell about 52 mm and one slot about 36 mm, scaled from Joey's hand in IMG_0954 and IMG_0956; no ruler measurement. Footprint with legs, from maps 1-6, 2-8, 3-11.

accepts: a marble flying off the M-10 lip
top of a block under the tail tip

physics.batteries: 2 AA in the body, screw cover on the back; three-way Off/Music+SFX/SFX switch and Music Selection button
physics.behaviour: Stunt and marble store. Marbles fly into the mouth. A metal marble is detected by the magnetic trigger: the mouth snaps, the body straightens with a dino sound, and every marble inside rolls out down the tail to the block under the tip. A plain marble does not trigger it: yellow light and a sound, and it stays inside until a metal marble fires it. A hand lifts the head to rearm it. Gravity moves the marbles; electronics make only light and sound. Without batteries the trigger state is unknown.

evidence.shows: Magnetic trigger; mouth snaps and body straightens for Magic Stunt marbles; marbles roll down the tail; plain marbles do not snap, yellow light and sound
Switch and button, 2 AA, legs snap to the body
Marble up M-10 into mouth; head down; metal marble in, plain marble rolling off tail; hand lifts head with tail rising; lock icons
Level 1: M-10 lip at mouth; tail tip over B4 height 2, leading to T-05, T-02 and the M-61 foot
Level 2: M-10 lip at mouth, tail tip over E2 height 2, in front of the M-61 tray
Level 3: M-10 lip at mouth; tail tip over A5 height 2, leading to T-02, A3 and M-56
Real body from behind: orange and brown ribbed back, speaker grille, square hole in head

assumptions: Head and tail are linked and a hand rearms it: read from plan page 02, third panel.
Origin is the midpoint between the feet. Mouth height 3.5 follows M-10 lip at support height plus 1.5 with feet on the floor. Level 2 lifts each foot 1 slot and also lifts M-10 by 1.
Tail tip height with body straightened is estimated.
faces uses E=+x, W=-x, S=+y, N=-y, in the piece's own frame. Heights are slots above the floor when the piece stands on the floor or, where stated, above the top of its supports.
